title: Cite the agency, not the website
idea: data.un.org is the route, not the source.
summary: The most common citation error with data.un.org is citing data.un.org. Cite the agency that produced the figure, and name the platform as the route.

transcript.text: This is the most common mistake made with the platform, and it is a one-word fix.
You searched, you found your number, and now you are writing the footnote.
Under every chart and every headline figure is a source line. On this one it reads Global S D G Database. That is the body that produced the number.
And it is a live link. Follow it and you land on the producing agency, where the methodology and the terms of use live.
So do not cite data dot U N dot org. That is the route you took, not the authority. Cite the agency, and mention the platform as where you accessed it.
Producer, indicator, place, year, then the platform as the route. Five parts, and nobody can take the figure apart.

deeper.label: Build a citation in four styles

keep: Citation pattern: Agency, Indicator, Place, Year. Accessed via data.un.org.
